data.strFullDescription:
[b]Action-Packed Raids[/b]
[list][*]Select your troops and fight your way along the defense path that other players set up for their base.
[*]Spearhead your troops as King -or Queen- and unleash magic on anything that crosses your path.
[*]Customize your gear, upgrade your armor and take useful companions into battle.[/list]

[b]Strategic Defense Planning[/b]
[list][*]Set up different types of towers and blockades to stop or stall other players from knocking down your castle gate.
[*]The composition of the defense units is crucial to avoid being defeated.
[*]Upgrade your buildings, towers and blockades and units so they can withstand even the strongest opponents.[/list]

[b]Alliances provide competitive edge[/b]
[list][*]You can play the game casually by yourself, but you can also create or join an Alliance to add greater depth to your game experience.
[*]By playing in an Alliance, you can increase your gains and develop your base considerably faster.
[*]Alliances from all over the world are pitted against each other in recurring Alliance Events. During these competitions strategic thinking and coordination is essential to gain and keep the upper hand.[/list]

Royal Revolt 2 is a very successful and long-running FTP mobile game which was ported to Steam
data.strSnippet: Royal Revolt 2 is an asynchronous PvP Reverse Tower Defense game full of medieval magic and action-laden battles.Can you set up your defenses so other Kings and Queens can't crash your castle gates? We're throwing down the gauntlet. Will you pick it up?
